contract.claim: Exact infinite-family identifiability modulo radical and finite gap-based peeling bounds.
contract.exact_surrogate: Finite atomic moment/Prony reconstruction with rational nodes and weights.
contract.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction exact and mpmath 180 decimal digits
contract.pass_meaning: Exact surrogate identities verified; numerical examples within analytic envelopes.
contract.failure_meaning: A violated finite assertion requires implementation or bound review; it is not automatically a counterexample to the infinite theorem.
contract.resource_bounds: Finite support enumeration up to 100000; no adaptive or unbounded search.
